verdict.rationale: Reducto documents async job processing (run_job/job IDs), a batch queue with a 20% discount for high-volume work, presigned URLs up to 5GB, and Svix webhooks with retries — all supporting large-scale pipelines. However, there is no documented rate-limit table or explicit throughput/SLA-per-page numbers in the evidence, and one hands-on report notes Reducto 'struggled with long documents' (300+ pages) compared to an alternative, raising doubt about predictable throughput at true scale. Missing for 10: explicit published rate limits (requests/min or pages/min), quantified throughput benchmarks, and independent corroboration of million-page batch runs.
